introHtml: Custom heavyweight work shirts are built to withstand the rigors of daily wear on job sites, in warehouses, and in the field. Unlike standard-weight shirts, heavyweight fabrics resist tearing and hold up to repeated washing, making them a smart investment for teams that need durable, professional uniforms. Choose from options like the Ladies' Sweater Blazer for a polished look that doesn't sacrifice toughness.
